title: Claude Code in the terminal
description: You’ll learn what the terminal is, install the tools you need and build your first website of your own with Claude Code. No prior experience needed.
audience: For you if you want to learn to use the terminal, also known as the command line. You install the tools yourself and learn how programmers work along the way.

topics.title: Basics
topics.description: What vibe coding is and the basic ideas behind the terminal, folders and Git.

modules.title: What is vibe coding?
modules.summary: AI writes the code, you steer. What it’s good for and what it isn’t (yet).

modules.title: The terminal and commands
modules.summary: The terminal is like texting with your computer. Try it in the simulator.

modules.title: Folders and paths
modules.summary: What a folder and a path are, and how you know which folder you’re in.

modules.title: Git and GitHub
modules.summary: Git is like save points in a game, GitHub is the cloud where your saves are kept.

modules.title: Chat or AI agent?
modules.summary: A chat answers, an agent acts: it creates files and runs commands on your computer.

topics.title: Installations
topics.description: Step by step, you install all the tools you need for Claude Code and check that they work.

modules.title: The terminal
modules.summary: On Windows you install PowerShell 7, on a Mac you open the built-in Terminal.

modules.title: GitHub account
modules.summary: You create a GitHub account and protect it with two-factor authentication.

modules.title: Git
modules.summary: You install Git, which you use to make checkpoints of your project.

modules.title: VS Code
modules.summary: A recommended code editor that shows your project’s files. Not required.

modules.title: GitHub CLI
modules.summary: You install the gh tool and use it to sign in to GitHub.

modules.title: Claude plan
modules.summary: What kind of plan you need for Claude Code and where to find up-to-date prices.

modules.title: Claude Code
modules.summary: You install Claude Code and sign in.

modules.title: Checklist
modules.summary: All the version checks on one page: is everything ready?

topics.title: Claude Code principles
topics.description: How to steer Claude Code well and safely.

modules.title: Your first conversation
modules.summary: How to start Claude Code in a folder and how to talk to it.

modules.title: A good prompt
modules.summary: Say what, why and within which limits. Bad and good examples side by side.

modules.title: Plan mode
modules.summary: Plan first, build second.

modules.title: CLAUDE.md
modules.summary: The project’s sticky note that Claude reads every time.

modules.title: Permissions and safety
modules.summary: Read what you approve. Passwords and keys stay out of the conversation and out of GitHub.

modules.title: Git as checkpoints
modules.summary: Save before a big change and learn how to go back.

modules.title: Context
modules.summary: What Claude remembers from the conversation and when it’s worth starting with a clean slate.

topics.title: Your first project
topics.description: You build a small website of your own (HTML, CSS and JavaScript) with Claude Code and send it to GitHub.

modules.title: Project folder
modules.summary: You create a folder for the project and start Git tracking.

modules.title: Plan
modules.summary: You plan with Claude in plan mode what goes on the site.

modules.title: Build
modules.summary: Claude builds the site, you open it in the browser and ask for changes.

modules.title: To GitHub
modules.summary: You save your work as a commit and send it to your own GitHub repo.

modules.title: Bonus: publish
modules.summary: Optional extra task: put your site on the web at its own address with GitHub Pages.
